summary: OFS Capital Corp filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026, disclosing that wholly owned subsidiary OFS SBIC I, LP admitted a third-party investor acquiring 56.62% of its limited partnership interests for $52,279,500, all distributed to the Company. SBIC I, LP holds 400 Class A shares of Pfanstiehl Holdings, roughly 84.0% of OFS net assets and 31.8% of total investments at June 30, 2026 fair value. OFS SBIC I GP retains sole control as general partner; proceeds fund new debt and equity investments and general corporate purposes. Watch retained-control valuation marks and redeployment pace.
